verdict.rationale: smolagents is explicitly designed to take a natural-language task string and let the agent decide and execute actions (agent.run("Calculate the sum of numbers from 1 to 10")), with CLI utilities (smolagent, webagent) for running agents without writing code, and this is corroborated by a hands-on community example showing an agent handling a natural-language text-to-SQL task step by step. missing for 10: broader independent benchmarking of natural-language command reliability across diverse task types.
